architecture_boundary.candidate_universe: all direct-anchor or at-most-two-typed-edge candidates outside the original RAW top five; no utility, score, keyword, threshold, or positive-gain filter
architecture_boundary.complete_state_space: the no-op RAW set plus every distinct final set reachable by replacing one or two distinct original RAW slots with one or two distinct candidates; candidate assignment to output rank is canonicalized because utility and the evaluator are set-invariant
architecture_boundary.evaluator: fixed typed pairwise conditional set energy over whole-final-set deltas from RAW, including global coverage, candidate-candidate, candidate-retained-RAW, typed-connectivity, path-complementarity, and deletion-loss features
architecture_boundary.fit: one no-intercept lambda-one L2 convex solve over exact complete-set utility deltas; each training item has total weight one, each utility-delta stratum within an item has equal total weight, and every state in a stratum is enumerated with equal weight
architecture_boundary.inference: one global argmax over the complete state space with the zero-vector zero-score no-op in the same competition; ties prefer fewer replacements and then canonical state order
architecture_boundary.mechanism_difference: the hypothesis class scores complete interacting evidence sets and globally chooses a set; it is not the stopped sequential additive marginal-action scorer, a residual recipe, a prompt, a threshold, or a gate
architecture_boundary.validation: leave exactly one of A_form, A_hold, and M_search out; accumulate per-item sufficient statistics once and never use held labels in the fold fit
